title: Accelsius to Deploy Two-Phase Direct-To-Chip Liquid Cooling System at EdgeConneX Global Training Center
summary: AUSTIN, Texas, August 27, 2026--Accelsius®, a leader in two-phase, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, today announced the deployment of its commercial IR150, the industry’s first fully integrated IT rack plus CDU, at the EdgeConneX Global Training Center in Houston, Texas. The installation marks the next milestone in the commercial rollout of IR150 following its market introduction at Nvidia’s GTC event and general availability announcement at Data Center World.
